newsitem.title: CANADA: Ontario Hydro sets C$500 mln 8.25 pct 30-year bond.
newsitem.headline: Ontario Hydro sets C$500 mln 8.25 pct 30-year bond.

text.p: Ontario Hydro issued an 8.25 percent bond due June 22, 2026 worth C$500 million on Tuesday, said lead manager RBC Dominion Securities Inc.
The issue was priced at C$102.792 with a yield of 8.001 percent and spread of 27 basis points over the Government of Canada 8.0 percent bond due June 1, 2023.

The issue will be delivered on September 4, 1996. The size of the total issue is now C$1 billion, RBC Dominion said. On June 4, Ontario Hydro issued another C$500 million 8.25 percent bond due June 22, 2026.
